decision.explanation: Source D2 explicitly states that 'Anglican Retirement Villages, Diocese of Sydney, is, in fact, an integral part of Anglicare Sydney' and lists it as a subsidiary in the ACNC register. Source D1 contains a fictional narrative about Wii Menu but explicitly denies any real-world connection ('no evidence to suggest... is part of Wii Menu'). The only valid entity satisfying the 'part of' relation based on factual assertions in the provided text is Anglicare Sydney.
